news.title: 7 reasons why UNI is ranked #1 Public University in the Midwest
news.summary_en: You’ve probably heard the great news by now: UNI has been ranked the No. 1 public regional university in the Midwest by U.S. News & World Report.  Here's why!

news.title: UNI ranked No. 1 in the Midwest by U.S. News & World Report
news.summary_en: For the first time, the University of Northern Iowa has earned the distinction of being named the No. 1 public regional university in the Midwest by U.S. News & World Report.
